body.input: Which robotics companies opened an office in Germany in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available reporting, the following robotics companies opened or expanded offices/facilities in Germany in 2026:

1. **Agile Robots** — Opened a new production site in Fürstenfeldbruck, near Munich (early 2026), with capacity to produce up to 10,000 humanoid robots annually. The company also opened its new global headquarters in Munich's Sendling district.

2. **Doosan Robotics** (South Korea) — Opened an expanded European branch in Frankfurt, Germany, on May 19, 2026. The new office enhances localized sales, service, training, and customer support capabilities across Europe.

These are the robotics companies for which specific 2026 office or facility openings in Germany were confirmed in available sources. Other robotics firms (such as Neura Robotics, RobCo, and Wandelbots) are active in Germany but were already established there prior to 2026.

explainability.content: Agile Robots opened a new production site in Fürstenfeldbruck near Munich in early 2026, establishing a manufacturing facility in Germany.
The Fürstenfeldbruck plant can produce up to 10,000 legged and wheeled humanoid robots annually, confirming the scale of the German operation.
Agile Robots also opened its global headquarters in Munich’s Sendling district, indicating a corporate office presence in Germany in 2026.
Doosan Robotics announced the opening of an expanded European branch in Frankfurt on May 19, 2026, establishing a new office in Germany.
The Frankfurt office enhances localized sales, service, training, and customer support across Europe, confirming its operational role in Germany.

context.content:
## What the Money Is For

Zhaopeng Chen, the founder and chief executive, wants to use the capital mainly for three things: entering the U.S. market, new industrial applications and manufacturing in Bavaria. Early this year, Agile Robots opened a new plant in Fürstenfeldbruck, near Munich, that is designed for up to 10,000 humanoid robots a year. The company is taking the technology straight from the lab into industrial series production, Mr. Chen said.

According to The New York Times, the round is also meant to prepare for a possible initial public offering. There is no timetable for that. Physical A.I. could help Europe close its gap with the United States and China in artificial intelligence, Mr. Chen argued there.

## What Agile Robots Does [...] Agile Robots has also grown through acquisitions, including that of Franka Robotics, a Munich maker of robot arms. For A.I., the company relies on partners: A research partnership with Google DeepMind has been running since the spring, followed in October by a humanoid platform based on Nvidia’s robotics models and a logistics project with Audi. Besides Germany, the company also manufactures in China and India, and its earlier investors include Xiaomi, the Chinese electronics company.

## SoftBank Is Buying Its Way Into Robotics [...] ## The Competition

Money is currently flowing into many robot makers. In Germany, Neura Robotics, of Metzingen, raised up to $1.4 billion (about €1.3 billion) in the summer, from investors including Tether, Amazon and, likewise, Nvidia. The Munich start-up RobCo has become a unicorn. In the United States, Apptronik raised $520 million (about €467 million) at a valuation of about $5 billion, and then there are Figure, 1X and Tesla with Optimus, as well as Unitree of China.
